summary.text: Eddie Day Pashinski is a Democrat who has represented Pennsylvania's 121st Legislative District, which includes the City of Wilkes-Barre, since he was first elected in 2006, and he has been Democratic chairman of the House Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Pashinski graduated from Wilkes University with a Bachelor of Science degree in music education. His biography says he spent 38 years as a music teacher and choral director at the Greater Nanticoke Area School District, and held union positions there including president of the Greater Nanticoke Area Education Association.
He also served as PACE Director and Region Chairman for PSEA at the state level.

In the House he has previously served on the Insurance, State Government, Human Services, Aging, Gaming and Commerce committees, and he is vice-chair of the Center for Rural PA and chair of the Grandparents Raising Grandchildren and Legislative Sportsmen's caucuses.

After the 2011 floods he spearheaded a legislative package to help homeowners and small businesses recover, and his language supporting the Homegrown by Heroes program was included in the 2019 PA Farm Bill.
He has four children, seven grandchildren and one great-grandchild.
